hard_constraints: For voltage below reactive_deadband_pu, reactive current requirement is k*(deadband-voltage), clipped by current_limit_pu.
Active current is limited by remaining apparent-current capability after reactive priority.
FRT compliance requires ride-through for the given voltage-time samples and meeting reactive-current requirement.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.
Optional rationale text is ignored by the deterministic evaluator.
